chunks: Hariz narrated from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام that he said:

If a man has urine and blood dripping from him while he is in salat (prayer), he should take a pouch and place cotton in it, then attach it to himself and put his private organ into it, then pray. He should combine the two salats of Zuhr and 'Asr, delaying Zuhr and bringing 'Asr forward, with one adhan and two iqamahs; and he should delay Maghrib and bring 'Isha' forward, with one adhan and two iqamahs; and he should do that in the morning prayer as well.

key_terms.إِقَامَتَيْنِ: with two iqamahs, one for each prayer
key_terms.قُطْنًا: cotton placed in the pouch for absorption
key_terms.كِيسًا: a pouch or bag used to contain discharge

ai.seo_question: How should a person pray if urine or blood continuously drips during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a person who experiences continuous discharge of urine and blood during salat (prayer). It instructs him to contain the impurity as much as possible and organize his prayers in a way that reduces hardship while preserving worship.
